name: Notification Daemon & Notification Center
shortDesc: Receives D-Bus desktop notifications and presents toasts & slide-out control center.
detailedDesc: Implements org.freedesktop.Notifications to alert you of incoming messages, emails, and system events.

phase.title: Desktop Shell & Core Plumbings
phase.description: Status bars, launchers, notification systems, on-screen displays, and wallpaper managers.

packages.name: SwayNC (Sway Notification Center) (Recommended)
packages.description: Complete notification daemon with a slide-out control center panel featuring quick toggles (DND, Wi-Fi, volume, screenshot).
pros: Custom widget toggles (audio, night light, DND)
cons: Slightly higher RAM usage than minimal toast-only daemons like mako

packages.name: Mako
packages.description: Lightweight notification daemon for Wayland compositors supporting wlroots and Hyprland.
cons: No historical notification center or quick-settings drawer

packages.name: Dunst
packages.description: Classic lightweight and highly customizable notification daemon with layer-shell support.
cons: Traditional UI layout; no modern slider panel
